item.text:
**5B.1 — Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**  
**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning positive on distributive intent, but weaker on long-term sustainability. AMLO clearly directed large resources toward transfers, wages, education, and infrastructure for poorer households and regions. The counterweight is that he also weakened institutions needed for durable prosperity and used some spending in electorally timed ways.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| + | [200 puntos del Sexto Informe de Gobierno](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/200-puntos-del-sexto-informe-de-gobierno/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-09-01 | The sixth report claimed 5.1 million people left poverty, the minimum wage more than doubled in real terms, Indigenous lands and water were restored, and large-scale pensions, disability support, and scholarships were expanded. | 5B.1 |
| + | [Gobierno federal destina 7.9 billones de pesos a Programas para el Bienestar y obras de infraestructura](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-destina-7-9-billones-de-pesos-a-programas-para-el-bienestar-y-obras-de-infraestructura/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-31 | The administration said it reoriented spending toward welfare programs and infrastructure, funding pensions, scholarships, youth employment, housing, fertiliser, and other direct supports at unusually large scale. | 5B.1 |
| + | [Dinamismo de la economía redujo la pobreza durante la Cuarta Transformación](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/dinamismo-de-la-economia-redujo-la-pobreza-durante-la-cuarta-transformacion/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-09-05 | AMLO argued the model combined public investment, labor participation, foreign direct investment, and private investment to reduce poverty and inequality while creating jobs through infrastructure. | 5B.1 |
| + | [Programas para el Bienestar alcanzan inversión sin precedentes de 2.7 billones de pesos...](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/programas-para-el-bienestar-alcanzan-inversion-sin-precedentes-de-2-7-billones-de-pesos-en-el-gobierno-de-la-cuarta-transformacion/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-25 | The government said 79% of households would receive at least one program in 2024, showing very broad coverage of direct supports. | 5B.1 |
| - | [Programas para el Bienestar alcanzan inversión sin precedentes de 2.7 billones de pesos...](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/programas-para-el-bienestar-alcanzan-inversion-sin-precedentes-de-2-7-billones-de-pesos-en-el-gobierno-de-la-cuarta-transformacion/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-25 | The same source says payments were advanced before the electoral blackout, which makes the program timing look at least partly oriented to maximizing short-term political support. | 5B.1, 4B.2 |
| - | [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | HRW said AMLO relied heavily on the military, transferred hundreds of government tasks to it, blocked transparency-body appointments, and limited access to information, all of which weaken the institutional basis for durable prosperity. | 5B.1, 4B.4, 4B.9 |
| - | [Mexico: Proposed Constitutional Changes Threaten Rights](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-08-30 | HRW warned the outgoing administration’s reform package would weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and erode privacy/transparency safeguards, risking long-run economic and institutional damage. | 5B.1, 4B.4, 4B.10 |
| - | [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04 | Reuters said AMLO’s INE overhaul was seen as cementing Morena’s hegemony; that points to political control taking priority over stable, rules-based prosperity. | 5B.1, 4B.2, 4B.5, 4B.10 |
| - | [Rampant extortion reveals corrosive hole in Mexico security strategy](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/rampant-extortion-reveals-corrosive-hole-in-mexico-security-strategy-3283251) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-25 | Reuters reported extortion was far above the level when AMLO took office, undercutting any claim that the broader economy and daily security environment had become sustainably healthier. | 5B.1 |

**Search gap:** I found strong evidence for broad redistributive intent and large-scale welfare spending, but little direct outside evidence that those gains were built on durable productivity or institutional strengthening. The clearest negatives are indirect: judicial/transparency weakening, militarization, and electorally timed transfers.
